description: A long, smoke-stained taproom where the furniture has been broken and mended so many times it now qualifies as a repeat offender. A knife is stuck in the bar for reasons the staff have stopped explaining.

items.name: a half-finished tankard
items.description: Best not to ask who finished the other half.

doorways.description: A shortcut through an alley toward Pseudopolis Yard.
A curtained doorway, unusually quiet behind it.
A door that swings both ways, mostly because it's missing a latch.
A trapdoor behind the bar, propped open with a chair leg.
A narrow staircase, several steps of which are only theoretical.
